A window slides over the stream. Each block holds literals and copies.
A copy names how far back it starts and how long it runs; a run of one
byte is a copy that overlaps itself: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.
A window slides over the stream. Each block holds literals and copies.
The decoder checks every length against its block, and every offset
against the bytes it has written, so a corrupt stream is a failure it
names, never a read outside the window.
